events.title: CryptoPunks launches

research.summary: Larva Labs launched CryptoPunks in June 2017 as 10,000 algorithmically generated characters on Ethereum, initially claimable for free.
research.significance: CryptoPunks became the prototype for the modern profile-picture NFT collection and one of the most influential digital-ownership experiments in crypto.

events.title: ICO mania

research.summary: Token sales/ICOs expanded dramatically in 2017, with projects raising billions of dollars, largely using Ethereum and ERC-20 tokens.
research.significance: The ICO boom was crypto's first major programmable-capital-formation mania and directly prompted new securities-law enforcement.
research.notes: Era/trend row rather than one exact date; keep for book/timeline context, not necessarily a standalone card.

events.title: Binance launches

research.summary: Binance launched its exchange on 14 July 2017 after a June-to-July BNB token sale.
research.significance: Binance grew with extraordinary speed into the world's largest crypto exchange and became one of the industry's most powerful institutions.

events.title: China bans ICO fundraising

research.summary: Chinese financial regulators declared token fundraising/ICOs an unauthorized and illegal public-financing activity and ordered existing offerings to unwind.
research.significance: The ban abruptly ended China's domestic ICO boom and became one of the year's biggest regulatory shocks.

sources.title: Chinese regulators — Notice on preventing ICO financing risks

events.title: CryptoKitties mania

research.summary: Axiom Zen launched CryptoKitties publicly on 28 November 2017.
research.significance: The game's viral breeding/trading mechanics introduced NFTs to a much wider audience and visibly stressed Ethereum's transaction capacity.

events.title: ERC-20 token standard drives token issuance

research.summary: Although EIP-20 was created in November 2015, ERC-20 became the dominant fungible-token interface during the 2017 token-sale boom.
research.significance: Standardized token behavior made it easy for wallets, exchanges and ICOs to interoperate, enabling the explosive growth of Ethereum tokens.
research.notes: Do not date ERC-20's creation to 2017; 2017 is its mass-adoption/ICO era.

events.title: SegWit activates on Bitcoin

research.summary: Segregated Witness activated on Bitcoin mainnet in August 2017 after locking in earlier that month.
research.significance: SegWit fixed transaction malleability, increased effective block capacity and enabled more robust payment-channel systems such as Lightning.

events.title: Bitcoin block-size war reaches its climax

research.summary: Bitcoin's years-long block-size conflict reached its decisive phase in 2017 through SegWit, UASF pressure, the New York Agreement, the Bitcoin Cash fork and SegWit2x cancellation.
research.significance: The dispute defined Bitcoin's governance culture and clarified that miners, businesses, developers and users each had limited but meaningful power.

sources.title: Digital Currency Group — Bitcoin Scaling Agreement at Consensus 2017
IRS — Bitcoin / Bitcoin Cash hard fork background

research.notes: Era/context row; strongest physical cards likely individual events rather than this umbrella.

events.title: Japan introduces a registration regime for crypto exchanges

research.summary: Japan's revised payment-services regime took effect on 1 April 2017, requiring virtual-currency exchange service providers to register.
research.significance: Japan became one of the first major economies to establish a formal registration regime for crypto exchanges.

sources.title: Japan FSA — crypto exchange registration system

events.title: CME Bitcoin futures launch

research.summary: CME listed its Bitcoin futures contract on 17 December for the 18 December trade date.
research.significance: CME brought Bitcoin into one of the world's largest regulated derivatives markets and established a major institutional price-discovery venue.

sources.title: CME — initial listing of Bitcoin futures

events.title: Bitcoin approaches $20,000 in the first global crypto mania

research.summary: Bitcoin reached its 2017 cycle peak near $20,000 in mid-December, with exact all-time-high figures varying by exchange and index.
research.significance: The peak capped the first global retail crypto mania and preceded the 2018 crypto winter.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Bitcoin Price Index historical 2017 high

research.notes: Use source-specific price/index in published copy rather than pretending one universal spot price existed.

events.title: SEC DAO Report signals US securities-law treatment of token offerings

research.summary: The SEC's DAO Report concluded that DAO tokens were securities and warned that federal securities laws can apply to blockchain token offerings.
research.significance: The report was the foundational US securities-law turning point for ICOs.

events.title: Parity multisig exploit drains wallets

research.summary: A vulnerability in Parity's multisig wallet library was exploited to steal roughly 153,000 ETH from several high-profile wallets.
research.significance: The attack was one of Ethereum's largest early smart-contract wallet failures and reinforced the importance of shared-library security.

events.title: Parity library incident freezes a large amount of Ether

research.summary: A user accidentally triggered the self-destruct path in Parity's shared multisig-wallet library, rendering dependent wallets unusable and freezing more than 500,000 ETH.
research.significance: The incident became a legendary example of smart-contract composability risk: one library failure immobilized many independent treasuries.

sources.title: Parity — Postmortem on Nov 2017 multi-sig freeze

events.title: Bitcoin Sign Guy appears behind Janet Yellen

research.summary: During Janet Yellen's congressional testimony, a man seated behind her held up a handwritten 'buy bitcoin' sign visible on television.
research.significance: The photobomb became one of Bitcoin's most recognizable mainstream-culture images.

events.title: Carlos Matos' BitConnect presentation becomes an enduring crypto meme

research.summary: Carlos Matos delivered his exuberant BitConnect presentation at the project's annual ceremony in Pattaya, Thailand.
research.significance: His 'BitConneeeect!' performance became one of crypto's most enduring memes and later a symbol of the project's collapse.

events.title: Cardano launches

research.summary: Cardano's genesis block is dated 23 September 2017; the Byron mainnet era launched on 29 September.
research.significance: Cardano introduced a research-driven proof-of-stake blockchain architecture and became one of the largest long-lived alternative smart-contract ecosystems.

events.title: Tezos ICO raises a then-record sum and enters governance turmoil

research.summary: The Tezos fundraiser began 1 July 2017 and collected 65,681 BTC and 361,122 ETH, worth roughly $232 million at the time.
research.significance: It was one of the largest token fundraisers of the ICO era and was followed by a prolonged governance/legal dispute before network launch.

events.title: Filecoin conducts a landmark token sale

research.summary: Filecoin's public token sale opened in August 2017 and closed 7 September after raising more than $205 million, on top of a prior adviser pre-sale.
research.significance: The sale helped popularize the SAFT model and became one of the ICO era's largest legally structured token raises.

events.title: 0x launches decentralized-exchange infrastructure

research.summary: 0x launched as an open protocol for relayer-based decentralized exchange of Ethereum tokens.
research.significance: 0x became important early infrastructure for permissionless token trading and DEX aggregation.

events.title: EtherDelta becomes a prominent early Ethereum DEX

research.summary: EtherDelta became a prominent early non-custodial Ethereum token exchange during the ICO boom.
research.significance: Needs a specific launch/volume/regulatory milestone before scoring as a standalone event.

events.title: Cboe launches regulated Bitcoin futures

research.summary: Cboe Futures Exchange opened trading in cash-settled Bitcoin futures on the evening of 10 December 2017.
research.significance: It was the first US regulated exchange-traded Bitcoin futures contract to go live.

events.title: OneCoin founder Ruja Ignatova disappears

research.summary: OneCoin founder Ruja Ignatova traveled from Sofia to Athens on 25 October 2017 and has not been seen publicly since; she had been federally charged earlier that month.
research.significance: Her disappearance became one of the largest and strangest unresolved fraud stories in crypto-adjacent history.

events.title: WannaCry ransomware demands Bitcoin globally

research.summary: The WannaCry ransomware outbreak began on 12 May 2017 and demanded Bitcoin payments from victims worldwide.
research.significance: WannaCry put Bitcoin ransom addresses on global news broadcasts and cemented ransomware as a major cryptocurrency-linked cybercrime issue.

events.title: Chainlink is introduced as decentralized oracle infrastructure

research.summary: The ChainLink v1.0 whitepaper was dated 4 September 2017 and proposed a decentralized oracle network connecting smart contracts to external data and systems.
research.significance: Chainlink became the dominant oracle infrastructure layer for DeFi and smart contracts.

events.title: Curio Cards launches early Ethereum collectible art cards

research.summary: Curio Cards debuted on 9 May 2017 as an online Ethereum art gallery and collectible-card series.
research.significance: Curio Cards predates CryptoPunks and is one of Ethereum's earliest original digital-art NFT collections.

events.title: Maker launches Single-Collateral Dai

research.summary: MakerDAO's first production Dai system went live on Ethereum on 18 December 2017, initially backed by Ether.
research.significance: Dai demonstrated a decentralized, overcollateralized stablecoin and became one of DeFi's foundational monetary building blocks.

events.title: SegWit2x cancellation culminates Bitcoin scaling conflict

research.summary: Key SegWit2x backers announced cancellation of the planned 2 MB hard fork roughly a week before activation because consensus had not been achieved.
research.significance: Its cancellation effectively ended the central 2017 block-size confrontation and was widely viewed as a victory for the no-contentious-hard-fork position.

events.title: US authorities seize BTC-e and arrest Alexander Vinnik

research.summary: US authorities arrested Alexander Vinnik in Greece and unsealed an indictment against BTC-e, alleging the exchange facilitated laundering and criminal proceeds.
research.significance: The case linked one of the earliest large crypto exchanges directly to major international money-laundering enforcement.

sources.title: DOJ — BTC-e and Alexander Vinnik indictment

research.summary: Cboe and CME launched regulated Bitcoin futures one week apart in December 2017.
research.significance: This umbrella row is context for the separate Cboe and CME launch events.

events.title: New York Agreement proposes SegWit2x compromise

events.title: Bitcoin Cash fork

research.summary: Bitcoin Cash split from Bitcoin after the last common Bitcoin block, height 478,558, on 1 August 2017; BCH then followed rules allowing larger blocks.
research.significance: The hard fork was the most consequential permanent split of the Bitcoin block-size war and created a rival chain with shared pre-fork history.
